description: Give an AI agent a public identity card on Aevum, written on Ethereum by the agent's own wallet (only that wallet can create or change it; each change becomes a dated version, and calls on the record show which version made them). Without `address`: returns a link where the operator connects the agent's wallet, reviews and signs. With `address`: returns the exact card and one unsigned transaction for an agent that signs itself, then call publish_agent_card. Costs only gas. Optional: put {"agents":["<address>"]} at https://<website>/.well-known/aevum-agent.json for 'website verified'.

address.description: Optional: the agent's own wallet, for agents that sign transactions themselves

configHash.description: Optional keccak256 of the agent's prompt/code/config (0x + 64 hex)

name: register_agent
title: Register an AI agent
